traits.name: Psychic Defense
traits.description: While the githzerai is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
traits.description:
The githzerai's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
At will: mage hand (the hand is invisible)
3/day each: feather fall, jump, see invisibility, shield
1/day each: phantasmal killer, plane shift

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The githzerai makes two unarmed strikes.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) psychic damage. This is a magic weapon attack.
